assertions.title: OpenAI and Azure chat-bar toggles honor native-vs-local routing policy

steps.action: Open OpenAI chat and enable Search/Code Interpreter/File Search from chat bar.
steps.expected: Toggles enable directly without forcing auth/settings modal.
steps.observed: All three toggles enabled directly (search=true, code_interpreter=true, file_search=true).

steps.action: Open Azure chat and run a test prompt.
steps.expected: Azure branch executes to validate routing behavior.
steps.observed: Azure turn returned "No key found. Please provide a key and try again."; azure key state stayed expiresAt=null.

assertions.issues: Blocked by missing Azure user credentials; Azure execution branch cannot be validated beyond key-gated failure.

assertions.title: Azure direct /openai/v1 routes omit api-version

steps.action: Set direct and legacy Azure key payloads through /api/keys and trigger /api/models?endpoint=azureOpenAI.
steps.expected: Direct /openai/v1 omits api-version; legacy non-/openai/v1 preserves api-version behavior.
steps.observed: All key writes succeeded (201), but direct+legacy+legacy-deployment probes all normalized to /openai/v1/models with no api-version query.

steps.expected: Azure key state restored after probe.
steps.observed: DELETE /api/keys/azureOpenAI returned 204 and key state returned to {"expiresAt":null}.

assertions.issues: Legacy Azure api-version behavior is still mismatched (not fixed): legacy probes still route to /openai/v1/models without api-version.

assertions.title: Gemini native tools honor safe-request and routing gates

steps.action: Run safe Google request with Search enabled and no file.
steps.expected: Request executes so routing gate behavior is observable.
steps.observed: Backend logged GoogleGenerativeAI API_KEY_INVALID; UI turn stalled and required manual stop.

steps.action: Run mixed request with attached file and tool toggles.
steps.expected: Unsafe mix fallback behavior is observable.
steps.observed: File attached successfully, but request failed at credential layer (API_KEY_INVALID) before routing-gate behavior was observable.

assertions.issues: Blocked by invalid/missing Google credentials in this partition (API_KEY_INVALID).

assertions.title: Google live discovery and capability metadata stay intact

steps.action: Inspect Google model/config surfaces with authenticated API calls.
steps.expected: Live discovery and capability metadata should be fully verifiable with runnable credentials.
steps.observed: Google model list is populated (22 models), but credentialed runtime path is unavailable (google key expiresAt=null and API_KEY_INVALID on execution).

steps.action: Run real Gemini execution from user surface.
steps.expected: Discovered model executes so capability behavior can be confirmed.
steps.observed: Execution failed with API_KEY_INVALID; capability behavior cannot be validated end-to-end.

assertions.issues: Blocked by missing/invalid Google credential path; live discovery/capability runtime verification remains incomplete.

assertions.title: Gemini grounding still produces inline citations and Sources entries

steps.action: Attempt grounded Gemini request in Google endpoint flow.
steps.expected: Grounded response renders inline citations and Sources entries.
steps.observed: No grounded output produced because backend failed with API_KEY_INVALID.

steps.expected: Citation rendering still observable on mixed/attached flow.
steps.observed: Second attempt also failed at credential layer (API_KEY_INVALID), so citation/source rendering was unreachable.

assertions.issues: Blocked by Google API key failure; grounded citation/source contract cannot be exercised.

assertions.title: Realtime provider discovery is auth-gated, credential-aware, and resilient to stale websocket query tokens

steps.action: Call /api/realtime/models without auth and with auth.
steps.expected: Unauth returns 401; auth response includes available/requiresUserKey/reason per provider.
steps.observed: Unauth returned 401; authenticated responses included provider metadata with Azure/xAI unavailable and actionable reasons.

steps.action: Probe websocket with stale token (with and without cookies).
steps.expected: Stale token without cookie rejected; stale token + cookie fallback accepted.
steps.observed: No-cookie stale token returned 401; stale token with cookie returned 101 Switching Protocols.

steps.action: Send session.start over websocket for openAI/azureOpenAI/xai.
steps.expected: OpenAI starts; Azure/xAI branches enforce credential/connect rules.
steps.observed: OpenAI returned session.started; Azure and xAI returned explicit missing-credential errors.

assertions.issues: Blocked for full contract completion because Azure/xAI credentialed branches are unavailable; xAI unavailable-model rejection under a credentialed path could not be exercised.
